graders.evidence:
Here's the same thing in plain words:

I took a first look at the code, and I only got part of the picture.

The archive feature is already half there. The server route for it lives in `src/server.js` at line 36. It only runs when the archive flag is turned on. But the page has no button or link for it, so nobody can actually use it today.

My rough sense is this is a medium-sized job — not tiny, not huge. That's still a guess until I finish the research.

I'm working from commit `3f1c2a0`, and nothing new has landed since, so I'm up to date.

Here's what I plan to spend on this. After the research, I'll come back with one round of questions — five at most. I'll use one helper to search the codebase. And I'll have a tech lead plus one other reviewer check the plan before we build.
